    ONE BET, SAID PLAINLY: SNDK, STX and LITE in shares and AMD and AVGO in the option column are the same AI-hardware dip-buy in a QQQ -1.32%, 10-year-at-5% tape - five lines, one bet - and the LRCX put is that factor's hedge, not a separate idea; the PANW long beside the CRWD short is one cyber pair. The pyramid has all 16 seats UNRANKED, so no leader and no weight (R33); the Decoder is SHADOW (R27), its option votes (NOW 58, LRCX 55) printed beside the medians and outside my calibration weighting. The neural net disagrees sharply with the LRCX put (+14.68% 5d), the LMT call (-4.92%) and the SNDK long (-5.00%), agrees with LITE (+8.55%), and carries no weight beyond a note. Legs I would not have chosen: LMT (a 62.93 mark under its 66.80 intrinsic on OI 309) and LRCX (OI 305, -11.57% to break-even); they ship as the room's. What invalidates the day's leading ideas: closes through NOW 113.51, TTD 14.15, EXPE 290.35, AMZN 248.41 or CVS 80.73, and an SPY close above its prior close, which falsifies the continuation call; kills on two or more of SNDK, STX, LITE, AMD and AVGO at one close fail the AI-hardware bet as one. HORIZON SPLIT across the twenty shipped lines: 3 intraday (TTWO, LITE, STX - out at today's close), 13 swing (ABNB, CRWD, PANW, SNDK; NOW, TTD, PG, LMT, EXPE, AMD, GEV, AVGO, AAPL), 4 position (AMZN, CVS, GOOGL, LRCX). This is research, not advice; nothing executes. HOUSE RULES, decided before the session and not revisited inside it: (1) STAKES - share lines flat at 1.0 (R81); option legs at 1.0, with EXPE, AMD, GEV and AVGO at 0.5 under R4-OVERFLOW as the desk writes it, and no chair override anywhere (R129(a)). That is 8.0 option units beside 10.0 share units, no add on any losing line and no re-sizing. (2) EXITS - each share line exits on its close-basis kill or at its stated horizon, whichever comes first, so TTWO, LITE and STX close at today's close. Each option leg follows its EXIT line: ratchet at its break-even, kill on the underlying's close, else close on 2026-11-19 for NOW, TTD, PG, LMT, EXPE, AMD, GEV and AVGO, 2026-11-13 for AAPL and 2026-12-03 for LRCX. At the stand-in delta 0.5 (no delta served; it is wrong for in-the-money legs) NOW, PG, AMD, GEV, AVGO, AAPL and LRCX spend the whole premium before the kill, so the premium is the real stop; TTD keeps 0.27 of 1.06, EXPE 1.46 of 18.30 and LMT 37.78 of 62.93 (LMT's near-1 delta makes most of its premium the real stop), and LMT's ratchet 597.93 already sits under its 601.80 freeze price, so a close at or above it settles that leg at its first close. Kills on two or more of SNDK, STX, LITE, AMD and AVGO at one close are read as one AI-hardware bet failing, not as separate bad draws. (3) WINDFALL - when a leg's served mark rises to 2 x its premium at a freeze, half is banked at that mark and the record is written before the next freeze (R148); the other half rides to its own exit. No held contract's freeze mark is served this morning, so held claims read WINDFALL STATE UNWRITTEN, and the R155(b) nightly writer and the next court settle them; nothing is filled retroactively. Desk, R92/R12 - the memo's listings against the persisted book: share: PASS; option: DIFF PRINTED (R92)
